# shim

> shim is a B2B AI gateway that sits between applications and the OpenAI, Anthropic and Google APIs. Callers keep the provider's own SDK and change only its base URL. shim masks personal data and secrets before a request leaves and restores them in the answer, applies rate, token and catalog admission, accounts tokens and cost per request, and returns provider-native payloads, errors and streams. The community gateway (Apache-2.0) needs no external services; the enterprise edition (Elastic-2.0, under `ee/`) adds tenants, budgets, audit evidence and private model deployments.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): what shim does, the quickstart and the settings that matter first
- [Cookbook](docs/COOKBOOK.md): SDK setup, tags and cost, scan, privacy actions, errors and retries, warnings, streaming, observability, LiteLLM and Portkey in front of shim
- [Current architecture](docs/CURRENT_ARCHITECTURE.md): the request path, product boundaries, error codes and contracts
- [Developer guide](DEVELOPER_GUIDE.md): where code lives, runtime invariants and the required gates

- [Diagnostic metadata](ee/docs/DIAGNOSTIC_METADATA.md): every field shim records per request and its null behaviour

- [Offline releases](ee/docs/OFFLINE_RELEASES.md): signed releases and offline bundles
